lines: She’s still so cute, I think.
I can’t even stare at that any longer.
I have nothing to brag about.
Yet I’m always looking for you.
It’s me who longs for you more than anyone.
Because it’s me today and tomorrow.
I have to tell you I love you.
Before we can’t meet any more.
Yearning for you never goes the way I wish.
It isn’t something that just started now.
It didn’t begin at this moment.
Would you become a god or a Buddha,
I stroke your head and you smile.
I picture days like that, then
It’s me who longs for you more than anyone.
Because it’s me today and tomorrow.
I have to tell you I love you.
Before we can’t meet any more.
every day I wonder what you wish for,
I never know the things that truly matter.
It’s me who longs for you more than anyone.
Because it’s me today and tomorrow.
I have to tell you I love you.
Before we can’t meet any more.
